row: We're the premier station for news, weather and sports in the Quad Cities. Our coverage area spans Iowa and Illinois and includes Davenport, Bettendorf, Moline and Rock Island as well as Sterling, Galesburg, Burlington and Clinton. Got a story you want to see on KWQC News' YouTube page? Email us at news@kwqc.com or call 563-823-KWQC.
